# Project Index for LLMs & AI Agents

> Solid 2.0 + Ark UI + Panda CSS 2.5 + SpacetimeDB + ConnectRPC Starter
> 2026 Modern SPA Foundation (Paved Path Edition)

## Architecture Constitution
All engineering rules, design system invariants, and Solid 2.0 contracts are unified in **[AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)**.
Refer to `AGENTS.md` for:
- 15 AST-enforced architectural invariants (`scripts/check-rails.ts`).
- Closed-world token dictionary (`~/components/ui/tokens`).
- Systematic UI primitives and layout containers.
- Solid 2.0 reactive invariants and component guidelines.
